# doc-services
> Document extraction to text/Markdown with learning backend preference, AGPL-free OCR, and content-based privacy screening.

## Metadata
- Version: 0.1.1 (Frozen per T-20260920-167562623)
- License: MIT
- Last-checked: 2026-10-18
- Status: Active development / Production ready
- Repository: https://github.com/ellmos-ai/doc-services
- Organization: https://github.com/ellmos-ai
- Umbrella: https://github.com/open-bricks
- Tests: 59 passed, 1 skipped (100% green)

## Core Modules & API

- `doc_services.extract`:
  - `extrahieren(pfad, reg=None, lernen=True, nur_backend=None, produces=None)` -> `Ergebnis`
  - Resolves file format via `format_von(pfad)` and runs extraction through preference chain.
  - Supports `produces="text"` or `produces="markdown"` to narrow backends without losing fallbacks.
  - Implements XML element deduplication for merged DOCX table cells (preventing token duplication).

- `doc_services.ocr`:
  - `ocr_bild(pfad, sprache="deu+eng")` -> `OCRErgebnis`
  - `ocr_pdf(pfad, sprache="deu+eng", seiten=None, dpi=300)` -> `OCRErgebnis`
  - PDF rasterization strictly uses `pypdfium2` (BSD-3-Clause / Apache-2.0). PyMuPDF (`fitz`, AGPL) is excluded.

- `doc_services.privacy`:
  - `darf_weitergegeben_werden(pfad_oder_text, ist_text=False, erlaube_gelb=False)` -> `(bool, Befund)`
  - Content-based inspection for IBAN, Tax IDs, SSN, healthcare records, API keys, private keys.
  - Default is fail-closed (RED and YELLOW block). Secrets are masked in generated reports.
  - Bounded inspection: max_bytes screening limit with incomplete-screening guardrail.

- `doc_services.config`:
  - `registry(profil_pfad=None, config_pfad=None)` -> `Registry`
  - Separates catalogue (`profil.json`) from host configuration (`config.json`).
  - Learning preference tracking (successes and failures counted; reordering is proposed, not silently applied).

## Four-View Architectural Topology

1. View 1: CLI, Registry & Host Situation Subsystem (`registry`, `profil.json`, `config.json`, `lagebericht()`)
2. View 2: Backend Engine Selection, Extraction & OCR Subsystem (`extrahieren`, `pypdfium2`, `tc`-deduplication)
3. View 3: Privacy Gate, Fail-Closed Classifier & Content Screening (`darf_weitergegeben_werden()`, RED/YELLOW/GRÜN)
4. View 4: Learning Preferences, Metric Tracking & Evaluation (`umsortierung_vorschlagen()`, empirical counts)

## Key Invariants (INV-LOCAL-01 to INV-SLA-10)

- INV-LOCAL-01: Zero network egress: operates 100% offline.
- INV-LOCAL-02: Unprivileged user mode: runs as `RunAsInvoker`.
- INV-LOCAL-03: Permissive licensing: zero AGPL/copyleft dependencies (`pypdfium2` only).
- INV-LOCAL-04: Fail-closed privacy gate: blocks sensitive disclosures (RED/YELLOW).
- INV-LOCAL-05: Merged table cell deduplication in DOCX via XML `tc` element identity.
- INV-LOCAL-06: CI workflow hardening with timeout-minutes and concurrency cancellation.
- INV-LOCAL-07: Multi-host cloud-sync and lock protection in `.gitignore`.
- INV-LOCAL-08: Modern PEP 621 metadata standardisation in `pyproject.toml`.
- INV-LOCAL-09: Version parity and immutability (0.1.1 frozen per T-20260920-167562623).
- INV-SLA-10:   Binding 48-hour security response SLA and 5-day triage commitment.

## Verification Commands

- `python -m pytest -ra -v`: Run full contract and unit test suite.
- `python -m ruff check .`: Lint python source files.
- `python -m compileall -q doc_services tests docs`: Validate python syntax.
- `git diff --check`: Verify clean git status and whitespace.
